# Sface: NIM Atlas

> Sface is a Nimiq Pay Mini App game that teaches Nimiq payment and network concepts through a playable adventure. NIM Atlas is the world explored by the player.

## Product

- [Play Sface](https://sface.site/): Enter Pay Harbor, choose Explorer or Builder, and begin The Last Lantern.
- [Source and engineering notes](https://github.com/iziedking/sface): Review the public implementation and safety boundaries.
- [Nimiq Mini Apps](https://nimiq.dev/mini-apps/): Official platform documentation used by the learning content.

## Important boundaries

- The free core adventure works in local practice mode without a wallet.
- Live TestAlbatross payment mode requires an explicit player action in Nimiq Pay.
- A provider lookup or transaction hash is never treated as payment proof.
- Scores, shared-world progress, ranks, and rewards are shown only when server-verified data is available.
- Mainnet expansions and payouts remain disabled until their named owner gates are approved.

## Historical material

The repository preserves former Cycle I and Rescue Relay source and records for administrator-only historical access. They are not the current public Sface experience.
